text:
英语词汇 · 北师高中 · 第 79 单元

from time to time
不时地
例句：People from the church would come by my trailer from time to time to tell me they were still praying for me, and that they hoped I would come back to Jesus before I wound up in hell.
教会的人时不时会到我的拖车上来，告诉我他们依然在为我祈祷，希望我不要在去往地狱的道路上越走越远，早日回到耶稣我主的身边。
例句：Sometimes going over the top is good, if you can let yourself go from time to time, people will notice.
有时挣脱束缚是好的，如果你能够让自己一次又一次地挣脱束缚，人们会注意到你的。

result in

例句：This will result in output containing both the starting and ending addresses of the compiled code for each method.
这将会导致在输出结果中包含每个方法已编译的代码的起始地址和结束地址。
例句：This meeting should result in some change in how they work for the coming sprints, because they work to continually improve their team and practice effectiveness.
这个会议会导致迎接下一个冲刺阶段所做工作的一些转变，因为他们会不断工作以提高团队的实践效率。
例句：In this case, requests from one service policy which demand excessive CPU and lead to overload could result in breached service goals for the other policy or for both policies.
在这种情况下，一个服务策略中的请求需要过多 CPU 资源，这会导致过载，进而导致另一个策略或这两个策略的服务目标被破坏。

caution
音标：英 /'kɔːʃ(ə)n/  美 /'kɔʃən/

例句：The physician must exercise caution when prescribing antidepressants.

scratch
音标：英 /skrætʃ/  美 /skrætʃ/
n. 痕迹或划伤

scold
音标：英 /skəʊld/  美 /skold/
vt. 骂，责骂
例句：Do not scold the puppy, but simply and firmly say ‘no’.
不要责骂小狗，但要干脆利落地说“不”。

forbid
音标：英 /fə'bɪd/  美 /fɚ'bɪd/
vt. (forbade,forbidden)禁止，不准
例句：Lack of space forbids listing the names of all those who contributed.
由于篇幅限制，无法列出所有捐款人的姓名。

run into
撞上
例句：Wang agreed to sell IBM Systems last year after it ran into financial problems.
IBM公司遭遇财政问题后，王去年同意出售该公司的操作系统。

音标：英 /'ɪmɪteɪt/  美 /'ɪmɪtet/

音标：英 /pʊt ɒn/  美 /pʊt ɑn/

regardless of

音标：英 /'pjʊəlɪ/  美 /'pjʊrli/

例句：I do it purely and simply for the money.
